name: advanced-transform
description: A slim transform gizmo with Unity-style modes (E move, R rotate, T scale) on whatever you select in god mode: global or local XYZ move arrows, rotate rings with an arc grabber under the cursor and adjustable thickness, a white four-way free-move pad that can ride surfaces, End snaps to the floor, Home realigns to default orientation, per-axis and uniform scale cubes (ctrl mid-drag snaps). Ctrl+click builds a group that moves, turns, scales and deletes together; Del deletes the group; Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copy and paste a piece or a whole group.
